Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The test checks the blend surface, volume, bounds, mesh closure, and mesh deviation. It joins the existing kernel import suite.

## Previous finding

Fixed. The latest review of #3949 required a replacement branch without a closing reference to #2578. This PR has one commit, `8c3606da03a1c2e4334eb057c9e51b27d791667f`, which uses `Refs #2578`. Its history excludes the old closing commit. The PR body also ends with `Refs #2578`. The decision note keeps the release fixture and STEP comparison open. Issue #2578 remains open.

The two test source files match the final head of #3949 exactly. I read the complete replacement diff.

## Local results

The trial merge with upstream main `707dac12a85f9744640ef2f682fd5653f1fa83b9` succeeded. Its first parent is the PR head. I checked the laws against that upstream main's AGENTS.md.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-kernel --no-run` | Passed |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | Passed; all 8 `solidcraft_import` tests passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-kernel --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |
| Light release build | Passed |
| Motion light, lib | 7 passed |
| Motion light, `adaptive_troch_island` | 1 passed |
| Motion light, `adaptive_troch_neck` | 1 passed |
| Motion light, `adaptive_troch_parallel` | 1 passed |
| App light, `pocket_pass_start` | 1 passed |

All checks I ran passed. No GitHub runner was used.

## Extra suites run

None. No fixture directory or importer code changed. No post, operation, motion code, catalog, or recorded program changed. The catalog suites are outside this diff. The body records the author's parallel catalog timeouts and green serial rerun; I did not repeat those runs.

## Mutations and goldens

I repeated the history check without changing code: the old history was RED because it contained a closing reference. The replacement history was GREEN. The safety tier does not apply: this PR changes only tests and a decision note. I did not repeat the decoder mutation. No goldens moved. No UI changed, so screenshots are not required.

## Requested before merge

None.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
Left for the maintainer: self-review only (author marker does not count). No merge by the sweep.
